title: Reaction Games
shortDescription: Fast-paced games where players compete to react first or hit the perfect moment. Ideal for quick challenges, high energy moments, and instant audience engagement.
longDescription: A collection of high-energy reaction games where speed and timing decide the winner. It might be a Pistolero-style quick-draw duel, a race-start launch, a smash-the-buzzer sprint, or a precision challenge to hit the perfect moment. Each format is grasped in seconds, creates instant tension and laughter, and rewards back-to-back replays. Perfect for events, exhibitions, and brand activations that thrive on crowd energy and memorable, reflex-driven moments. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scoring, scene management, and the links to leaderboard and data outputs.

highlights.title: A Whole Family of Fast Games
highlights.description: One idea, many formats. Players press, tap, step, or trigger at exactly the right moment: a quick-draw duel, a smash-the-buzzer sprint, a race-start launch on pedals, a stop-it-on-target precision test, or a whack-the-light frenzy. Pick the games that fit the audience and the space, and swap between them on the same setup.

highlights.title: Learned in a Second, Replayed for Hours
highlights.description: There is nothing to explain: a light, a sound, or a countdown, then react. That zero learning curve makes anyone step up, and the instant win-or-lose result pulls them straight back in for another round, which keeps queues moving and energy high.

highlights.title: Built to Draw and Hold a Crowd
highlights.description: Reaction games are as fun to watch as to play. The countdown tension, the near-misses, and the split-second winner turn bystanders into a cheering audience, which makes them a reliable crowd-puller for queues, stages, and booths.

highlights.title: Solo, Teams & Tournaments
highlights.description: Play it solo against an AI or the clock, head to head, or as team relays; run knockout brackets or a sudden-death final; tighten the timing window for pros; or add sponsor rounds with branded prizes. New input types and premium props slot in as paid upgrades.

highlights.title: Reskin the Showdown
highlights.description: Dress any reaction game in a world: a Wild West quick-draw, a sci-fi reflex test, a stadium race start, a TV game-show buzzer round, or a festive edition. The mechanic stays the same while the look, sound, and props change to fit the client.

highlights.title: Optional Reaction Data
highlights.description: Add a data layer to log reaction times, win rates, rounds played, and repeat plays, then export it for a post-event read on engagement and the fastest players in the room.

highlights.title: Wire It Into the Event
highlights.description: Pair it with a Leaderboard for a venue-wide fastest-reaction ranking, with Visitor Identificator to tie scores to each player, with Prize Draw to reward the quickest, or with Live Feed to put live results on screens around the space.

states.experience: A looping attract sequence runs a quick demo round and invites people to step up and react.
states.feedback: Idle animation, ambient sound, a clear step-in prompt.
states.configurable: Attract visuals, branding, demo game, audio bed.
states.data: Footfall near the station, attract-to-play conversion.

states.trigger: A host or the players pick a reaction game and how many play.
states.experience: The chosen format loads, the matching inputs activate, and a one-line rule explains what to do.
states.feedback: Game preview, input assignment, short how-to prompt.
states.configurable: Available games, default game, number of players, language.

states.trigger: Players take their inputs and the round is armed.
states.experience: Each side locks in and a short countdown builds the tension before the cue.
states.configurable: Countdown length, number of players, team setup.

states.trigger: The react signal fires (a light, a sound, or the countdown ending).
states.experience: Players react as fast as they can, and reacting before the cue counts as a fault.
states.feedback: Cue flash or sound, early-trigger penalty cue, live timing.
states.configurable: Cue type, hold variability, early-trigger rule, timing window.

states.experience: The winner and reaction times are shown for everyone, with an optional leaderboard entry.
states.feedback: Winner animation, reaction times, score card, optional leaderboard post.
states.configurable: Win logic, result copy, reward prompt, leaderboard push.

states.trigger: The result ends or the station times out.
states.experience: The station clears and returns to the attract loop for the next group.
states.feedback: Brief thanks, then a fade back to attract.
states.configurable: Timeout duration, end-screen call to action.
